newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end down amid dull trading.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end down amid dull trading.

text.p: Pakistan stocks ended down on Thursday in dull trading on lack of support from institutions and buying interest from investors before the 1997/98 (June-July) budget due in June, dealers said.
"The trading volume fell sharply and almost 70 percent of today's volume was generated by just three stocks mainly on speculative activity," dealer Sajjad Mankani said.
"The rest of the market was very quiet." Dealer Mohammad Iqbal said.
